manifest.name: space-ai-proposal
manifest.description: What a switched-off AI action wanted to do, waiting for a human: one proposal per space, permission and action key. Proposed until a human approves or refuses it; approval authorizes that one action and executes nothing by itself. Keyed by opaque control-plane space id.

migrations.name: create_space_ai_proposals
migrations.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS space_ai_proposals (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  space_id TEXT,
  permission TEXT,
  action_kind TEXT,
  action_key TEXT,
  summary TEXT,
  source_key TEXT UNIQUE,
  status TEXT CHECK(status IN ('proposed', 'approved', 'refused')),
  proposed_at TEXT,
  decided_by TEXT,
  decided_at TEXT,
  refusal_reason TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT;

bootstrap.name: pg_bootstrap_space_ai_proposals
bootstrap.sql:
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "accordo";

CREATE TABLE "accordo"."space_ai_proposals" (
  "id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  "space_id" TEXT,
  "permission" TEXT,
  "action_kind" TEXT,
  "action_key" TEXT,
  "summary" TEXT,
  "source_key" TEXT UNIQUE,
  "status" TEXT CHECK("status" IN ('proposed', 'approved', 'refused')),
  "proposed_at" TEXT,
  "decided_by" TEXT,
  "decided_at" TEXT,
  "refusal_reason" TEXT,
  "created_at" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);
